text_block_list.text: On the way back from my outing with Narita Brian, we decided to grab dinner, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: O-Oh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sis is eating out too, huh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well, I stepped out for a moment, you see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: Since we're here, why don't we eat together?
Since we're here, wanna eat together?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, since we're here.
Do you mind if I join you, Brian?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Do whatever you want. I don't care.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They let you add soup to the set meal, huh?
What should I do...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Corn soup, egg drop soup...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll have the hamburger steak set. Large portion of rice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …………And vegetable soup.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: O-Oh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That was delicious.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I must admit, I'm surprised. For someone who hates vegetables, you went and ordered vegetable soup.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"People other than Big Sis have been making noise around me lately.
I was just putting up a shield."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Honestly, what am I going to do with you...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Well, fine. Whatever the reason,
as long as you've grown even a little, that's enough."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, I'm still in the middle of shopping.
If you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I see. See ya, then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sorry for dragging you into this.
choice_data_list: I saw some real growth, so I'm satisfied!
I saw some real growth, so I'm satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh, you really are a lucky one...
choice_data_list: Let's keep putting in the effort!
Your hard work will definitely shine through in your running!
Your hard work will definitely show in your running!
Let me know if you ever need help.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh, you really are a lucky one...
choice_data_list: Let's keep putting in the effort!
Your hard work will definitely shine through in your running!
Your hard work will definitely show in your running!
Let me know if you ever need help.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's a pain. I refuse.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I'll keep it as one of the options.
That works, right?

Compared to before when she gave no thought to diet,
she seems to be steadily making progress,
even if it's only little by little.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe so.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Well, you can be the one to tell me
how I've changed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I can't see the changes in myself while I'm running, after all.

How has she changed now that she's conscious of her diet?
It seems I'll need to keep a close eye
on her going forward.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I already have that, and it's causing me quite a bit of trouble.
choice_data_list: Let me know if you're having trouble.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...It's gotten harder to eat
fast food out in the open."

Since she seems to be somewhat mindful of her diet now,
it might be okay to treat her to fast food
every once in a while.
